entries.title: Drakan: Order of the Flame
entries.definitive_edition: Original Windows release with compatibility patches

emulation.notes: Use available compatibility patches for modern systems; keep in mind community patches are unofficial.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Windows PC presentation with widescreen and stability improvements from modern compatibility work.

primary.version: Original Windows release with compatibility patches
primary.why: Drakan: Order of the Flame was released only for Windows, and no sourced official remaster or digital rerelease was identified; the original PC release with compatibility fixes is the best available route.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Windows copy with the official patch and compatibility guidance for modern systems.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Windows action-adventure release with ground combat and dragon-riding play.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced platform release and therefore the complete version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced alternate platform release was identified; the Windows release is both the original and complete version.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, or modern digital rerelease was identified; modern play relies on owned media and compatibility/community fixes.

entries.title: Drakan: The Ancients' Gates

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 with an owned PS2 copy for higher internal resolution and modern display options.

primary.how_to_play: Play the original PS2 disc on compatible hardware, or use PCSX2 with an owned copy for modern display options.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 sequel with expanded ground/dragon action-adventure systems.
